effect.name: Adicionar grão (Add Grain)
effect.desc: O Add Grain do After Effects: grão de filme com tamanho, cor, curva de sombras/luzes e animação — o mesmo grão do AE, pixel a pixel.
effect.desc-en: After Effects' Add Grain: film grain with size, color, shadow/highlight response and animation — the same grain as AE, pixel for pixel.
